text:
alex: quick check — i'm about to flip the new reranker_p2 feature flag to start a canary. planning: 3% global for 6h, then 20% over 24h if metrics look ok. thoughts on audience slicing and stop rules?

priya: sounds fine. what's the target metric for auto-stop? ctr? rerank-accuracy? latency?

alex: primary is rerank_top1_precision@10 (weekly baseline = 0.72). secondary: p50 latency (baseline = 85ms). stop if precision drops > 3% absolute OR p50 increases > 40ms for 10m window.

marco: ok — two asks: (1) can we exclude traffic from beta orgs and internal dev accounts? (2) include an immediate fallback to v2-reranker on errors/timeouts?

alex: yes to both. exclusion list will be the same as other experiments: include org_id not in ["beta-*", "dev-*"]. fallback = v2-reranker with 200ms timeout.

erin: pinging ops: canary-bot, please create a canary rule for this flag and add metric alerts for rerank_top1_precision and p50 latency.

canary-bot: create_canary_rule request received for flag reranker_p2. Settings: initial_slice=3%, ramp_to=20% over=24h, exclusion_tags=[beta, dev], fallback=v2-reranker, monitor_metrics=[rerank_top1_precision,p50_latency]. Reply with canary_id when ready. :gear:

priya: code-review note — flag gating is in handlers/rerank_toggle.go; small change to ensure cache invalidation when switching back to v2. i left a comment on the PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/442

marco: guardrail idea: add a soft-quorum check — if the sample size in the 3% slice is < 2k requests in 6h, don't ramp automatically. avoids noisy early stats.

alex: +1 on soft-quorum. add stop-rule: if sample_count < 2000 after 6h, hold and notify #eng-platform.

erin: ops note — adding an alert: reranker_p2_auto_hold if sample_count <2000 after 6h. alert to #eng-platform and #oncall.

priya: one more — can we tag experiment events with rollout_id for downstream analysis? makes it easier to join logs and evals.

alex: yes, rollout_id will be produced and added as metadata to request logs and eval events. i'll include in the PR template and canary description.

marco: quick sanity: add a manual kill switch (feature flag override to 0%) that ops can hit. we should document steps in the playbook.

alex: documented in the playbook draft (internal link): /docs/playbooks/feature-rollouts.md — added steps for manual_kill, validation queries, and rollback checklist.

canary-bot: canary_id=cb-20260305-83 created. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/canaries/cb-20260305-83. Auto-ramp will wait for soft-quorum and stop rules.

erin: awesome. i'll wire up the alerts and add runbook entries. tagging @oncall for awareness when we flip.

alex: thanks all — flipping the switch in ~30m after CI green and PR approvals. will update thread once live. :rocket:
